d: The Senior Accountant should lead and oversee accounting functions, ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance with financial regulations, and alignment with organizational, operational, and QHSE standards. The Senior Accountant plays a key role in financial analysis, reporting, and supporting strategic decision-making.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
Professional certifications such as CPA, ACCA, or CMA are highly preferred
Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of progressive experience in accounting
Prior experience in F&B or retail industry is an advantage
Experience in a supervisory or senior role is preferred
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and budgeting
Advanced proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel
Experience with accounting systems and ERP software
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Proficiency in English and Arabic is mandatory
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent certification preferred
Membership in a recognized accounting body is an advantage
r: Support the development and maintenance of a strong company image focused on excellence and customer satisfaction.
Handson work expereinces in Treasury controls and reporting, Cash flow management, Banking and credit facilities, LC/LG management and FX risk management
Maintain up-to-date professional and technical knowledge in accounting standards and practices.
Supervise and guide junior accounting staff, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in daily operations.
Contribute to team objectives and support cross-functional collaboration.
Review and approve journal entries and ensure proper reconciliation of general ledger and subsidiary accounts.
Perform detailed analysis of financial statements, expenditures, and revenue accounts.
Oversee month-end and year-end closing processes.
Monitor financial transactions and ensure accurate recording in the accounting system.
Prepare and review financial reports, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
Manage accounts payable and receivable processes, ensuring timely collections and payments.
Coordinate and support internal and external audits.
Ensure accurate preparation of invoices, statements, and financial documentation.
Analyze variances and provide recommendations to management.
Ensure full compliance with financial regulations, company policies, and accounting standards.
Implement and monitor internal controls to safeguard company assets.
Ensure adherence to QHSE policies and organizational procedures.
Promote a safe and compliant working environment in line with legal requirements.
Ensure proper utilization and safeguarding of company resources.
Prepare and present detailed financial reports to management.
Provide insights and recommendations based on financial analysis.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.
